blocks.text: Grammy-winning singer Miley Cyrus and musician Maxx Morando are officially married after five years of dating. The couple exchanged vows on Saturday, November 21, during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California. Their milestone celebration took place nearly a year after the “Flowers” hitmaker and the Liily drummer announced their engagement.
